$ docker compose ps -a
NAME          IMAGE                       COMMAND                  SERVICE   CREATED       STATUS                   PORTS
api-web-1     nginx:alpine                "/docker-entrypoint.…"   web       2 days ago    Up 2 days                0.0.0.0:8080->80/tcp

The compose ps table names each container of the project, the image it
runs, the service it belongs to and the ports it publishes. Containers
that exited stay in the table only with -a.
